content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **Searched** for the rule's detection triggers ("exclusive", "sole", "requirements from", "minimum"). Every hit is benign: warranty exclusivity (§ 5.2), *non*exclusive licence grants (§ 5.4, § 12.1), and "sole discretion" usages — none restrict our freedom to source elsewhere.
- **§ 14.16 (Freedom of Action)** works in our favour: "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others."
- **§ 11.5 (Capacity Planning)** and **§ 4.1 (Charges)** contain no volume, minimum-purchase or sole-source commitment; capacity decisions stay with us.
- **§ 14.11 (No Resale)** was reviewed and set aside — a downstream resale restriction is not exclusive dealing and belongs to a different rule (flagging it here would double-count the same term).

Result: the Agreement sits at the **preferred** position (no exclusivity binding the Customer), so nothing to negotiate under this rule.
